scope.operation: Retain and serialize typed GeoPositionMarker and SectionObject entities emitted through BLOCK callbacks, and decode the generated embedded-MTEXT GeoPositionMarker profile.
behavior: The concrete dx_iface retains typed GeoPositionMarker and SectionObject callback values and dispatches them to their DXF serializers.
Retained-byte accounting includes GeoPositionMarker notes and embedded MTEXT storage, plus SectionObject strings and bounded vertex arrays.
GeoPositionMarker parsing recognizes the serializer-generated Embedded Object/MTEXT scope, validates required marker and embedded-text fields, and retains the source record.

Generated ASCII and Binary controls verify named-BLOCK output, marker/section field sentinels, raw and applyExtrusion callback reads, and fail-closed capture for SectionObject vertex counts over the model limit.

limitations: The generated control is bounded to the AC1027 profile and does not establish physical producer coverage or native consumer semantics.
The tests do not prove complete BLOCK callback inventory, whole-document conversion, or source-to-output graph closure.
No captured-model whole-document import-to-export round-trip is claimed.
